packages.label: יִרְאָה וּבֵית
packages.label_en: Fear of God and the House
packages.reason: The central teaching of Torah #102 is that earned, self-generated fear of God (יִרְאָה שֶׁבָּאָה לָאָדָם מִכֹּחַ אָדָם עַצְמוֹ) is the condition under which prayer is heard and divine abundance descends. The Rebbe explicitly equates this yira with three things that share the same essential nature: (1) the 'house' (בֵּית) in the verse 'You shall be over MY HOUSE' — יִרְאָה is bechina of בֵּית, because the Talmud says 'woe to one who has a house but no courtyard' (i.e., Torah without yira is a building without a perimeter fence — yira IS the containing structure); (2) the צַדִּיק who 'rules through the fear of God' — this earned yira is called/named צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹקִים; (3) implicitly, the 'higher fear' (יִרְאָה עֶלְיוֹנָה) is the counterpart — same word, different essential nature, hence the contrast between the two types of yira is structural to the Torah. All these concepts share the domain of yira as a containing, ruling, earned quality — they are different expressions of the same essential dimension.

source_evidence.quote: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל בֵּיתִי. בֵּיתִי הוּא יִרְאָה
וְיִרְאָה זוֹ נִקְרָא: צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹקִים
source_evidence.bechina_statement: יִרְאָה עַצְמִית = צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹקִים (explicit equation using נִקְרָא)

packages.label: מַלְכוּת וְכִסֵּא
packages.reason: Torah #102 is explicitly about the revelation and growth of divine malkhut (God's kingship). The Rebbe equates the כִּסֵּא (throne) with מַלְכוּת — they share the same essential nature: both denote the royal/governing dimension. The 'diminution' (מִעוּט הַמַּלְכוּת) described by 'רַק הַכִּסֵּא' (only the throne exceeds you) is also the same concept expressed as meiut — reduced but inherent malkhut. Furthermore, the entire purpose of the teaching is that everything God created was for the revelation of His malkhut, and when He sends shefa to Israel they acknowledge 'מַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה'. Malkhut is the destination-concept of the Torah's entire argument. The kisse and malkhut share the same essential domain: the governing, royal, feminine-receptive divine dimension.

source_evidence.quote: רַק הַכִּסֵּא – הַיְנוּ מִעוּט הַמַּלְכוּת, כִּי 'רַק' הוּא מִעוּט, 'כִּסֵּא' הוּא מַלְכוּת

source_evidence.bechina_statement: The entire creation is bechina of the vessel/domain of revealing malkhut

packages.label: תְּפִלָּה וְתֵבוֹת
packages.label_en: Prayer and the Words as Vessels
packages.reason: The Rebbe teaches that prayer-words (תֵּבוֹת) are vessels (כֵּלִים) for receiving divine abundance (שֶׁפַע). The mouth-speech (פֶּה/פִּיךָ) is equated with prayer through the Onkelos translation ('וְעַל מֵימַר פֻּמָּךְ' = the prayer). These three — תְּפִלָּה, תֵּבוֹת, and פֶּה/מֵימַר פֻּמָּךְ — are all expressions of the same essential domain: the verbal/prayer dimension through which shefa is drawn down. They are not cause-and-effect (one does not produce the other); they are parallel aspects of the same thing — prayer IS words, words ARE vessels, and the mouth IS the prayer instrument. שֶׁפַע (abundance) is the content that flows through the vessel; it is included here as the paired concept to תֵּבוֹת-as-vessel.

source_evidence.bechina_statement: תֵּבוֹת = כֵּלִים לְקַבֵּל הַשֶּׁפַע (explicit equation: words ARE vessels)

source_evidence.quote: וְעַל פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כָּל עַמִּי, וְתַרְגּוּם אוּנְקְלוֹס: וְעַל מֵימַר פֻּמָּךְ, הַיְנוּ הַתְּפִלָּה
source_evidence.bechina_statement: פִּיךָ / מֵימַר פֻּמָּךְ = תְּפִלָּה (explicit equation using הַיְנוּ)

packages.label: קְּלִפּוֹת תַּחַת הַשְּׁכִינָה
packages.label_en: The Klipot Subdued under the Shechina
packages.reason: Torah #102 opens with the statement that God created everything only to reveal His kingship, 'and through this the klipot are subdued under the Shechina.' The klipot are the evil counterpart to malkhut — they are the domain of spiritual husks/impurity that oppose the Shechina's revelation. This is a two-concept package: the klipot themselves, and their subdued state (כְּנִיפִיּוּת / נִכְפָּפִין) under the Shechina. Though small (only 2 explicit nodes), this constitutes a genuine evil package because: (a) it is explicitly named in the source text in contrast to the positive malkhut revelation, (b) it reflects the good/evil mirror structure — Package 2 (malkhut revealed) mirrors Package 4 (klipot subdued). The klipot are not merely an eitza-obstacle; they are a bechina domain of the evil/husks dimension that the Torah structurally opposes to the Shechina.

source_evidence.quote: וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה, נִכְפָפִין הַקְּלִפּוֹת תַּחַת הַשְּׁכִינָה
source_evidence.bechina_statement: The klipot subdued state is the evil-mirror of malkhut's revelation — it names the domain that is the structural opposite of holy kingship in this Torah
